chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0590: Ji Ning's Savage Face-Slapping on Mount Chongyun
chapter_meta_description: An arrogant prince tries to steal Ji Ning's meditation seat on Mount Chongyun. He quickly learns the difference between a local bully and a cosmic-level power. A masterclass in Xianxia face-slapping begins.
og_title: A Terrible Mistake on Mount Chongyun
og_description: The prince of a minor dynasty tries to bully Ji Ning into giving up his seat. When Ji Ning simply glares, five Loose Immortals are sent flying. The real punchline comes when the prince calls for his master.
twitter_description: A classic Xianxia conflict where an arrogant prince picks a fight with the wrong cultivator. His threats and name-drops only lead to his own master being captured and humiliated.

lore_anchors.definition: The long-dead founder of the Sword Sect, a figure of supreme power whose sword-traces are the object of meditation on Mount Chongyun.
A major sect founded by Daofather Fuju, now diminished but still a top-tier power in the Three Realms.
A tier of disciple within a sect, granted significant status and authority above outer-disciples, protected by the sect's reputation.
A cultivator who failed the Heavenly Tribulation but survived, living on borrowed time with periodic attacks of ever-stronger tribulations.
The core internal energy center of a Ki Refiner, also the name of their cultivation realm.
A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power.
A power that manifests at a Sword Immortal's blade when they fully master the Grand Dao of the Sword and seek its deeper essence.

cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s a classic Xianxia conflict where an arrogant cultivator tries to steal a prime meditation spot from a weaker-looking one, leading to a power struggle.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't Ji Ning just kill them?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He was more annoyed than angry. Having a True God servant at his command, these ants weren't worth the effort of a full fight; a demonstration was enough.
A powerful sect founded by the deceased Daofather Fuju. It’s been in decline for ages but still has three True God-level experts.
